Body.Content:
What and why

We are introducing a new Copilot skill in PowerPoint, Summarize sales for leaders, that helps users create senior-leadership presentations summarizing sales performance, outlook, risks, and decisions.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late October 2026 and is expected to complete by early November 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users with access to Copilot in PowerPoint.

Platforms and services

  • PowerPoint on Windows (Win32), Mac, and web
  • Copilot in PowerPoint

What will happen

  • Users will be able to use a scenario-specific Copilot skill to create executive sales summary presentation drafts.
  • The skill can help sales teams prepare leadership updates more quickly.
  • The skill focuses presentations on sales performance, outlook, risks, and decisions.

Action required and recommendations

No admin action is required. We recommend that you inform sales leaders and PowerPoint Copilot users that this new skill is becoming available in PowerPoint on Windows (Win32), Mac, and web.

Compliance considerations

Does the change alter how existing customer data is processed, stored, or accessed (e.g., documents, emails, chats, etc.)?

  • No. This update adds a scenario-specific authoring skill in PowerPoint and does not introduce new customer data storage or change existing Microsoft 365 data handling pipelines.

Does the change introduce or significantly modify AI/ML or agent capabilities that interact with or provide access to customer data?

  • No. The change does not introduce a new AI system-of-record; it provides a new entry point/experience within existing Copilot in PowerPoint capabilities.

Does the change provide end users any new way of interacting with generative AI?

  • No. Users continue to interact through existing Copilot in PowerPoint experiences.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce a new Copilot skill, "Summarize sales for leaders," by early November 2026, enabling users to quickly create executive sales summary presentations focused on performance, outlook, risks, and decisions. No admin action or changes to data handling are required.
